council_map.notes: Found through the city council page link 'City Council districts can be found here' (saved in raw/greensburg-in/council.html) -> ArcGIS instant app item dc5c2e7b39f648dd9b0d46933a43bbe3 'Greensburg City Council Map' (raw/greensburg-in/lookup-item.json) -> web map a3ed8b97eda2499d8b4b531706dcae3e (raw/greensburg-in/webmap-data.json). Each layer returns count 1 (raw/greensburg-in/query-d1..d4.json; layer meta layer-d1..d4.json). Fields: district ('Greensburg District 1'..4), districtid, repname1, population. Layer repname1 values match the council page names (Fleetwood, King, Cain, Poling); at-large layers query-al1..3.json name Tressler, Carman, McKenzie. Layer name in the service is 'Electoral Districts'. Layers are _view layers of a Greensburg org (owner jffsteele); geometry not downloaded.

notes: Council went from 5 to 7 seats in 2024 (two at-large added; from a search result, not a saved page). Council page terms for all seven read 2024-2027. Mayor page: second term, sworn in Jan 1 2020 (text of 2019 election); a search summary listed clerk-treasurer Amy Borns caucused June 2021, not verified from a saved page. No city court judge found on the state court directory (raw/peru-in/court-directory.pdf, all-state list) for Greensburg.
